checks.name: Strict image parameters reject accessors and arbitrary paths without executing them
Text/unknown or cached-only capability cannot ask for or deliver an image
Declined explicit public-purpose confirmation produces no prepared image or receipt
Actual existing image utility decodes and prepares captured submitted image through original Hana/Pi
Current prepared image is admitted; unrelated history and summarization images remain local
Projection separates preparation/submission from actual response receipt and adds source only after response
Final provider gate rejects arbitrary remote images outside captured authority
New run clears image grants without replaying a received receipt or changing native image bodies
Image context estimate uses native image tokens, independent from base64 transport size
Supplier error never creates a received image receipt
A stopped owner cannot emit a late successful receipt or continue image delivery
Cold SQLite reopening preserves capture facts; deleted source uses local copy but still requires new confirmation
Changed captured file is rejected again at request time, after an earlier confirmation

boundary: Actual Electron/SQLite/captured-file/owned image utility. Confirmation and metadata responses are boundary fixtures, not official provider or rendered UI proof.
